name: /help
description: Show all Exocortex commands with concise purposes and guidance on where to start

steps.description: Load the compact command guide; no project scan or command execution

steps.action: Show a useful, compact help page
steps.context: With no argument, show the guide’s start-here section and grouped command table, with one short description per command. Include every canonical command once; keep the whole answer about 500 words or less. Explain that commands can inspect, draft, or request approved actions; help never invokes them. For /help COMMAND, read only .exocortex/commands/COMMAND.json after validating COMMAND against existing canonical filenames. Explain its purpose, typical use and read-only/write boundaries in a few paragraphs. Do not interpolate user text into a shell command. Do not read local memory, credentials or account state. Display host-appropriate command syntax where known; do not claim menu installation or visibility from this guide alone.
